summary: SecurityInsight 3.1 runs on a supported platform with data you can trust.

new.title: A supported, up-to-date platform
new.text: Since 3.0.85, SecurityInsight runs on Microsoft's long-term supported platform, on Microsoft images that are kept up to date with security fixes.

new.title: The Invardia support link
new.text: The part that sends health and run results to Invardia support is now called Invardia support link everywhere. One failed report never mails you; the Jobs page turns amber only after three in a row.

new.title: Every warning explained on invardia.com
new.text: Each warning SecurityInsight shows has its own page on invardia.com: what it means and who acts.

new.title: One list of who gets which mail
new.text: Configuration > Reports and alerts shows one row per person with a tick per report and alert. Get Started has a new step, Who gets the reports, with your current recipients filled in.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: The data sync never waits in silence, and overdue findings are counted everywhere. Also included: correlation decisions, deleted users, ServiceNow hand-off and management presentations.

fixes.title: Stuck steps open a support case
fixes.text: A step that runs far past its usual time without progress opens a support case at once.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: A safety check that held nothing back no longer raises a warning. A source is reported as behind only when its schedule says it should have been read.
